हेलो! मैंने Kuku FM (Android)  पर यह शो सुना और मुझे यकीन है कि आपको भी यह जरूर पसंद आएगा।

show.description:
Aditya once saved Nila’s life with his kidney so how did he end up breaking her with Nandini and costing her their baby?  
When Nila walks away and rebuilds her life with Suriya, will Aditya’s regret be enough to win her back?  
Or will Nila choose the man who stood by her and start over for good?
